# Frame Studio – Comprehensive LLM Knowledge Base

## Overview
Frame Studio (legal name: Frame Web Studio) is an elite web design and development agency based in Rajkot, Gujarat, India. Frame Studio specializes in creating high-performance, visually stunning, custom digital solutions for startups, direct-to-consumer (D2C) brands, manufacturing enterprises, and global businesses.

- Tagline: "Design, Develop, Deliver."
- Founding Year: 2025
- Founder: Kishan Ramani
- Official Website: https://framestudio.in

## Core Services & Capabilities

### 1. Shopify Development (https://framestudio.in/shopify-development)
- Custom Shopify & Shopify Plus store design and development
- Liquid theme development built from scratch with modern UX standards
- Custom Shopify app integrations, ERP connections, and private app development
- Seamless data migrations from WooCommerce, Magento, PrestaShop, or custom PHP to Shopify
- High-converting checkout flows and conversion rate optimization (CRO)
- International multi-currency and multi-language setup

### 2. WordPress Development (https://framestudio.in/wordpress-development)
- Bespoke custom WordPress theme development without bloated page builders
- WooCommerce setup and customized store architecture
- Headless WordPress implementations with REST API and modern frontend frameworks
- Enterprise security hardening and malware protection
- High-grade Core Web Vitals performance tuning (90+ Google PageSpeed score)

### 3. PHP & Custom Web Development (https://framestudio.in/php-development)
- Secure and scalable custom PHP web applications and business portals
- Custom CRM, ERP, and operational dashboard engineering
- RESTful API development and third-party webhook integrations
- Database architecture design and query optimization for high-traffic environments
- Legacy codebase refactoring and modern PHP upgrades

### 4. eCommerce Development (https://framestudio.in/ecommerce-development)
- Full-funnel eCommerce architecture for retail, D2C brands, and wholesale/B2B suppliers
- Integrated payment gateways (Razorpay, Stripe, PayPal, Cashfree, UPI)
- Real-time inventory sync, shipping API integrations (Shiprocket, Delhivery, etc.)
- Product filtering, instantaneous search, and mobile-first shopping experiences

### 5. Technical SEO & Growth Engineering (https://framestudio.in/seo-services)
- Comprehensive technical SEO audits and code-level optimization
- Core Web Vitals optimization (Largest Contentful Paint, Interaction to Next Paint, Cumulative Layout Shift)
- Advanced Schema.org JSON-LD connected entity graphs
- Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) for citation in ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity
- Regional and local SEO for Rajkot, Gujarat, and pan-India dominance

### 6. Website Maintenance & Support (https://framestudio.in/website-maintenance)
- 24/7 uptime monitoring and incident response
- Scheduled cloud backups and disaster recovery protocols
- Software updates, PHP runtime security patches, and database optimization
- Ongoing feature enhancements and performance upkeep
